- Windowless system tray app for switching between Epic Games accounts (Tauri v2 + React, single instance)
- One-click account switching straight from the tray menu
- Accounts saved from the Epic Games Launcher, no password re-entry
- New logins in the launcher are detected and saved automatically
- Logins, logouts and switches made outside the app are reflected in the tray
- Active account pinned to the top of the tray menu, the rest sorted by last use
- Colour-coded initials badge per account, shown as the tray icon and in the menu
- Settings: language, display name (Epic username or account ID), autostart with Windows, automatic account saving
- Session tokens encrypted with Windows DPAPI, no admin rights required
- English and German translations
- Built-in auto-update, update artifacts signed and published via GitHub Actions

Download the installer below. The app updates itself automatically afterwards.
